close_reason: /.well-known/mta-sts.txt handler added to axum router; check+clippy clean
description:
Add GET /.well-known/mta-sts.txt route to the axum router in crates/mail/src/server.rs (currently at build_router() ~line 265). Handler reads the per-domain MTA-STS config for the Host: header's domain and renders the policy file in RFC 8461 line format: 'version: STSv1
mode: <mode>
mx: <pattern>
...
max_age: <seconds>
'. Content-Type: text/plain. Policy-id is generated as hex(sha256(policy_body)) truncated to 32 chars. Return 404 for unconfigured domains. The domain-to-policy lookup must be case-insensitive on the Host: header.
title: Serve /.well-known/mta-sts.txt via axum
